mapper.select: SELECT tb.trip_boardID, tb.nick, tb.title, tb.start_date, tb.end_date, tb.input_date, r.region, d.img AS firstImageUrl, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trip_board_recom WHERE trip_boardID = tb.trip_boardID) AS recom_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trip_comment WHERE trip_boardID = tb.trip_boardID) AS comment_count FROM trip_board tb INNER JOIN region r ON tb.regionID = r.regionID LEFT JOIN trip_plan tp ON tb.trip_boardID = tp.trip_boardID AND tp.trip_day = 1 AND tp.visit_order = 1 LEFT JOIN course c ON tp.trip_planID = c.trip_planID LEFT JOIN DSTNT d ON c.DSTNTID = d.DSTNTID WHERE tb.status = 'Y' AND tb.nick = #{nick} ORDER BY tb.input_date DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT b.boardID, b.title, b.input_date, b.CategoryID, c.Category AS category FROM board b INNER JOIN board_recom br ON b.boardID = br.boardID INNER JOIN Category c ON b.CategoryID = c.CategoryID WHERE br.nick = #{nick} AND b.status = 'Y' ORDER BY b.input_date DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board b INNER JOIN board_recom br ON b.boardID = br.boardID WHERE br.nick = #{nick} AND b.status = 'Y'

SELECT b.boardID, b.title, b.input_date, b.CategoryID, c.Category AS category FROM board b INNER JOIN Category c ON b.CategoryID = c.CategoryID WHERE b.nick = #{nick} AND b.status = 'Y' ORDER BY b.input_date DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board b WHERE b.nick = #{nick} AND b.status = 'Y'

SELECT DISTINCT b.boardID, b.title, b.input_date AS board_date, b.CategoryID, c.Category AS category, cm.detail AS comment_text, cm.input_date AS comment_date FROM board b INNER JOIN comments cm ON b.boardID = cm.boardID INNER JOIN Category c ON b.CategoryID = c.CategoryID WHERE cm.nick = #{nick} AND b.status = 'Y' AND cm.status = 'Y' AND cm.input_date = ( SELECT MAX(input_date) FROM comments WHERE boardID = b.boardID AND nick = #{nick} AND status = 'Y' ) ORDER BY cm.input_date DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.boardID) FROM board b INNER JOIN comments cm ON b.boardID = cm.boardID WHERE cm.nick = #{nick} AND b.status = 'Y' AND cm.status = 'Y'

SELECT b.boardID, b.title, b.CategoryID, c.Category AS category, r.status AS report_status, CASE WHEN r.status = 'P' THEN '대기중' WHEN r.status = 'C' THEN '처리완료' END AS report_status_text FROM report r LEFT JOIN board b ON r.boardID = b.boardID LEFT JOIN Category c ON b.CategoryID = c.CategoryID WHERE r.nick = #{nick} AND b.status IN ('Y', 'B') -- Y: 정상, B: 블라인드 ORDER BY r.input_date DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report r LEFT JOIN board b ON r.boardID = b.boardID WHERE r.nick = #{nick} AND b.status IN ('Y', 'B')
